info.title: LumenBazaar Backend API
info.description: Facilitator, seller catalog, discovery, and conformance APIs for LumenBazaar.

x-rate-limiting.description: The API implements distributed rate limiting across all replicas using Redis. Each endpoint scope has different limits per 60-second window.

scopes.facilitator: Payment verification and settlement endpoints (verify, settle): 60 requests per minute per API key or IP
scopes.seller: Seller management endpoints (create, verify domain): 30 requests per minute per API key or IP
scopes.discovery: Resource discovery and catalog endpoints: 120 requests per minute per API key or IP

headers: x-ratelimit-limit: Maximum requests in current window
x-ratelimit-remaining: Requests remaining in current window
x-ratelimit-reset: ISO 8601 timestamp when window resets
retry-after: Seconds to wait before retrying (429 responses only, RFC 6585)
x-rate-limiting.identification: Authenticated seller API keys are identified by their key ID; other requests use the x-api-key header value if present, otherwise by request IP address (x-forwarded-for not trusted)
x-rate-limiting.behavior: During Redis unavailability, rate limiting degrades to in-memory per-instance limits, prioritizing availability over perfect enforcement

post.summary: Verify an exact Stellar x402 payment payload. The transaction memo and payment destinations are checked against the memo and muxed-account policy before verification.

amount.description: Amount in the token's atomic units.

transaction.description: Wallet-signed Stellar transaction envelope XDR. The transaction memo and payment destinations must satisfy the memo and muxed-account policy: memo types none, text (at most 28 bytes), id (uint64), hash and return (32 bytes) are accepted with a G-address destination; muxed-account (M...) and contract (C...) destinations are rejected with every memo type (error UNSUPPORTED_MEMO_OR_MUXED_ACCOUNT).

get.summary: Search paid resources by query and filters. Queries are scored against a deterministic cost budget (maximum 50) before execution; over-budget queries are rejected with QUERY_TOO_COMPLEX. See docs/api/search-query-limits.md.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text query. Maximum 200 characters and 20 terms; each term costs 2 against the query cost budget.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: Stellar network the resource settles on.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Asset code the resource accepts (for example, USDC).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Resource type.

parameters.name: sellerId
parameters.description: Only return resources owned by this seller.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response. Paging stops at the maximum result window of 1000 results; a cursor at or beyond that depth is rejected with RESULT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results per page. Default 25, maximum 100. A larger value is rejected with PAGE_SIZE_EXCEEDED before any database work runs. Counts toward the search query cost budget (1 per block of 10 results).
parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Conditional request (RFC 9110): one or more ETags, `*`, or a weak tag (`W/"..."`). When the current representation matches, the server returns 304 Not Modified with no body.
